external_coverage.exact_statement: For a finite-type scheme Z over a complete non-Archimedean real-valued field F, including trivial valuation, Z^an is obtained by gluing affine multiplicative-seminorm spaces extending |·|_F, with pointwise evaluation topology. Separated Z gives Hausdorff Z^an; projective Z gives compact Z^an; analytification is boundaryless over F.
Every local subring A of a field M is dominated by a valuation ring B whose fraction field is M (Stacks Project, Lemma 10.50.2).

For an injective local inclusion of valuation rings A⊂B with finite fraction-field extension M/F, the value-group index e=[Γ_B:Γ_A] and residue degree f=[κ_B:κ_A] are finite and satisfy ef≤[M:F] (Stacks Project, Lemma 15.125.2).

For projective Z over a complete non-Archimedean field and semiample Q-bundle A, the decreasing-FS-net psh cone is closed under finite maxima and decreasing limits; continuous psh metrics are uniform FS limits and uniform smooth semipositive limits (BE v3, Definition 7.2, Lemma 7.4, Corollaries 7.5–7.6, Theorem 7.14).
For geometrically reduced projective Z over complete valued F, continuous φ on a line bundle A satisfies d∞(∥·∥_{mφ_H},(∥·∥_{mφ})_H)=o(m) for every complete extension H/F (BE v3, Theorem 6.6).
For geometrically reduced projective Z over complete non-Archimedean F, continuous φ on semiample Q-bundle A is psh exactly when φ_H is psh, for every complete extension H/F (BE v3, Theorem 7.31).

On n-dimensional projective Z over a complete non-Archimedean field, continuous psh-regularizable metrics on Q-bundles A_1,…,A_n admit unique mixed Radon measures, symmetric and multiadditive, positive with mass (A_1⋯A_n), continuous from uniform to weak convergence, and compatible with complete scalar-extension pushforward (BE v3, Proposition 8.3, Theorem 8.4, Proposition 8.5).

For geometrically reduced projective Z over complete non-Archimedean F and continuous psh φ,ψ on semiample Q-bundle A, raw relative energy is monotone in φ, obeys cocycle and shift Vc laws, is V-Lipschitz in each metric, and is invariant under complete scalar extension, where V=(A^dim Z) (BE v3, Definition 9.13, Proposition 9.14).

On good Hausdorff non-Archimedean analytic spaces, including over trivially valued complete fields, CLD forms satisfy Stokes and Green with their stated support and boundary hypotheses. On boundaryless spaces the boundary terms vanish. For smooth real h, d'h∧d''h is strongly positive; products of semipositive (1,1)-forms are positive, and algebraic fundamental integration currents are positive (CLD v1, §§3.12, 5.1–5.4).

Every positive linear functional I on C(S,R), for compact Hausdorff S, is represented by a unique finite positive Radon measure λ, with λ(S)=I(1) (Riesz representation; Tao, 245B Notes 12, Theorem 24).

accepted_partial_scope: All complete characteristic-zero non-Archimedean fields, arbitrary-dimensional smooth geometrically integral projective varieties and actual ample rational bundles: completed-algebraic-closure quotient, actual all-point singular PSH and extended-energy/E1 descent, unique invariant Radon lift, continuous-test dual equality, and genuine continuous mixed-operator covariance with unchanged raw mass. General E1 operator/equation transfer is conditional on its explicit antecedents.
residual_original_gaps: General unbounded mixed operators, weighted limits, strict locality/comparison, normalized actual-potential compactness, envelope continuity/orthogonality/both-sign outer differentiation and original all-E1 target characterization/attainment/every-solution uniqueness over nontrivial and nondiscrete fields remain unestablished.
